app.title: Obsidian Property Studio
app.subtitle: Obsidian PKM v1.1.0
overview.title: Workspace Overview
overview.lead: Understand, design, and govern your Obsidian Properties. Operates entirely locally with strict read-only guarantees on your vault.
overview.not_scanned_desc: Please enter your Obsidian vault folder path in the Vault tab and run a scan.
action.discover_desc: Inspect property inventory, usage frequencies, and storage types across the vault or active scope.
action.design_desc: Propose properties based on your goals and reuse existing conventions without writing YAML.
action.fill_desc: Fill in values from your schema and generate valid frontmatter to copy into Obsidian.
action.relations_desc: Explore link candidates, broken references, and ambiguity between Source and Target Scopes.
action.health_desc: Audit naming drift, value drift, type conflicts, and orphaned properties with explainable metrics.
action.refactor_desc: Generate safe impact analyses for renaming, merging, or normalizing properties.
vault.title: Choose the vault you want to understand
vault.lead: Property Studio reads your vault and never changes it. Nothing is uploaded, no account or API key is needed, and no note is created, renamed or edited.
vault.untouched_desc: Checked {count} files against baseline manifest captured at scan time. No files were modified.
scope.title: Scope Selection
scope.lead: Focus analysis on Entire Vault, single folder, multiple folders, or specific notes. Uses in-memory filtering without disk rescanning.
discover.title: Discover Properties
discover.lead: Every property key found in your notes' frontmatter, how often it is used, how it is stored, and what can go wrong.
design.title: Design properties without writing YAML
design.lead: Describe what you want to manage in plain words. Proposes properties, explains their purpose, and checks against vault inventory.
fill.title: Fill in the values, copy valid frontmatter
fill.lead: A form built from your schema. The YAML produced is inspectable and ready to copy into Obsidian.
fill.invalid_status: ✕ Missing required fields or ambiguous values
refactor.title: Plan a property change safely
refactor.lead: Every plan is analysis only. Discloses affected notes and highlights areas requiring human decisions.
relations.title: Relationship Inbox
relations.lead: Property values and wikilinks pointing at other notes — exact matches, broken links, ambiguity, and drift.
health.title: Property health check
health.lead: A deterministic, explainable health score for your property layer with category breakdowns.
proposal.title: AI Proposal Import
proposal.lead: Import schema proposals from external Agents or Skills. Validated locally without external network dependencies.
